introduction: Oregon SNAP applications use ONE or the state’s other benefit-intake routes. All households must complete an interview when applying or renewing under the June 2026 rules.
description: Oregon SNAP applications use ONE or the state’s other benefit-intake routes. All households must complete an interview when applying or renewing under the June 2026 rules.

sections.who: ODHS checks Oregon residence, income and eligible status. Student and work rules can apply, and the agency reviews relevant exemptions.
sections.get: Approved food benefits help pay for groceries through the Oregon Trail EBT system.
sections.docs:
• Household income and requested expenses.
  • Identity and contact details.
  • Interview verification, including medical costs when relevant.
sections.apply:
1. Apply or renew

    Use the SNAP application link.

  2. Complete the interview

    Follow your appointment notice and ask for an interpreter if needed.

  3. Read the result

    Check the award, certification dates and reporting requirements.
sections.after: Complete periodic reports and renewals as instructed. Older adults should ask whether eligible out-of-pocket medical costs affect their calculation.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using SNAP eligibility and ongoing reporting, Interview requirements and support, June 2026 interview change. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: No. ODHS restored interviews for all households starting June 1, 2026.
The state’s interview guidance offers interpreter assistance.
Can an older adult’s medical costs matter?
ODHS says qualifying out-of-pocket costs for people 60 or older can offset income, with proof.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
